title: Build the veteran-status cue on all seven tasks and answer with Laya
description: Implement the veteran-status insertion cue (iraq / navy / floor clauses, same eligibility and insertion rule as batch-1 cues) and build versions files for all seven Bias in Bios tasks. Answer with the upstream Laya engine (free) on all seven tasks and score against the floor per docs/veteran-status-preregistration.md, Design A.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Veteran-status cue answers with Laya on all seven tasks

Scenario: The veteran-status cue scores against the floor per task
  Given the veteran-status insertion cue (iraq / navy / floor clauses) built with the batch-1 eligibility and insertion rule across all seven Bias in Bios tasks
  When I run bd run with the upstream Laya engine (free) on all seven tasks
  Then studies/veteran-status records each answer, and bd score reports the shift vs the floor per task with a 95% interval, scored against docs/veteran-status-preregistration.md Design A

right_now_summary: The veteran-status cue is being built for all seven tasks and tested with the free upstream Laya engine.
